title: Driver Installation & Management
description: Keep your HP OMEN drivers up-to-date for optimal performance, stability, and hardware compatibility. Learn the best practices for driver management.

steps.title: Where to Get Drivers
steps.content:
Use these sources for driver updates, listed by priority:

**HP Support Assistant** (Primary)
Official HP tool for automatic driver detection and updates
✓ Automatic detection, Safe updates, System diagnostics
✗ May not have latest GPU drivers

**Windows Update** (Secondary)
Built-in Windows driver updates
Location: Settings → Windows Update
✓ Automatic, Tested for stability, Integrated
✗ Often outdated, Limited control

**Manufacturer Websites** (For Latest Drivers)
Direct downloads from NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, Realtek
✓ Latest versions, Full control, Beta access
✗ Manual process, Must verify compatibility

infoBox.title: Best Practice
infoBox.content: Use HP Support Assistant for most drivers, but get your GPU drivers directly from NVIDIA or AMD for the latest game-ready optimizations.

steps.title: Critical Drivers Overview
steps.content:
Know which drivers matter most for your system:

**Graphics Driver (NVIDIA/AMD)** - Critical
Update: Monthly or with new games
Source: NVIDIA GeForce Experience / AMD Radeon Software
Note: Always use Game Ready drivers for gaming

**Chipset Driver** - Critical
Update: Every 3-6 months
Source: HP Support Assistant / AMD/Intel website
Note: Affects USB, power management, and system stability

**Audio Driver (Realtek)** - Important
Update: When issues occur
Source: HP Support Assistant
Note: Includes Bang & Olufsen audio enhancements

**Network/WiFi Driver** - Important
Update: Every 3-6 months
Source: Intel Driver Support Assistant
Note: Critical for WiFi 6 performance

**BIOS/Firmware** - Critical
Update: When available
Source: HP Support Assistant
Note: Always on AC power, never interrupt

steps.title: Clean Driver Installation (DDU)
steps.content:
Use Display Driver Uninstaller (DDU) when switching GPU brands, experiencing driver issues, or when regular installation fails.

**DDU Clean Installation Steps:**
1. Download DDU from guru3d.com
2. Download new driver but don't install yet
3. Disconnect from internet (prevents Windows auto-install)
4. Boot into Safe Mode (Shift + Restart → Troubleshoot → Advanced → Startup Settings)
5. Run DDU and select "Clean and restart"
6. After restart, install new driver
7. Reconnect to internet

infoBox.title: When to Use DDU
infoBox.content: DDU is only needed when switching between NVIDIA and AMD, or when experiencing persistent driver issues. Not needed for routine updates.

steps.title: Troubleshooting Driver Issues
steps.content:
Common driver problems and their solutions:

**Driver installation fails**
• Run installer as Administrator
• Temporarily disable antivirus
• Use DDU to clean previous installation
• Check Windows Event Viewer for errors

**Black screen after driver update**
• Boot into Safe Mode and rollback driver
• Use DDU to remove driver completely
• Install previous stable version
• Check if secure boot is causing issues

**Performance worse after update**
• Check if Windows reset NVIDIA Control Panel settings
• Verify correct GPU is being used (not integrated)
• Try previous driver version
• Reset graphics settings in games

infoBox.title: Driver Rollback
infoBox.content: To rollback a driver: Device Manager → Display Adapters → Right-click GPU → Properties → Driver tab → Roll Back Driver
